Question: Each of the letters \(W,\) \(X,\) \(Y,\) and \(Z\) represents a different integer in the set \(\{1,2,3,4\},\) but not necessarily in that order. They satisfy \[\dfrac{W}{X}-\dfrac{Y}{Z}=1\] What is the sum of \(W\) and \(Y?\)
